name: NSFDC Education Loan (Demo Placeholder)
description: Placeholder rule data modelled on the NSFDC education loan scheme. Rural and urban applicants have different annual family income limits. DEMO DATA ONLY - replace with the official document via the ingestion endpoint before relying on it.

source.note: Placeholder pending the official NSFDC document. Not an official source.

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must belong to a Scheduled Caste (SC) category.
Annual family income must not exceed the rural/urban limit (rural INR 81,000, urban INR 1,03,000).
Applicant age must be between 18 and 35 years.
Course must be an undergraduate, postgraduate, professional, diploma or certificate course.

financials.source_note: Demo financial parameters pending the official rate table.

claims: Annual family income limit is INR 81,000 for rural applicants and INR 1,03,000 for urban applicants.
The education loan interest rate is 10% per annum.
The maximum loan amount is INR 15,00,000.
